content: लुभ् I. €6 <ab>P.</ab> To bewilder, confound, perplex. --II. €4 <ab>P.</ab> (लुभ्यति, लुब्ध) .²1 To covet, long for, desire eagerly (with <ab>dat.</ab> or <ab>loc.</ab>); तथापि रामो लुलुभे मृगाय. .²2 To allure, entice. .²3 To be bewidered or perplexed, go astray. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (लोभयति-ते) .²1 To make greedy, cause to long for, produce or excite desire for; पुप्लुवे बहु लोभयन् <ls>Bk. 5. 48</ls>. .²2 To excite lust. .²3 To entice, seduce, allure, attract; लोभ्यमाननयनः श्लथांशुकैर्मेखलागुणपदैर्नितम्बिभिः <ls>R. 19. 26</ls>. .²4 To derange, disorder, disturb.
